method: Walked /photography/analytics at 390, 920 and 1280 pixels against the local dev server after removing the page's authentication gate and its two visitor-search panels. The page returns 200 with no redirect to /login. Recent Searches and Zero-Result Gallery Searches no longer render, and no visitor-typed text appears anywhere on the page. Total Views, Total Searches, Popular Photos, Bot Traffic Filtered, View Sources, Most Popular Photos and Album Reach all render with live data. Document scrollWidth equals clientWidth at all three widths, so nothing overflows horizontally and the stat grid reflows 4-up to 1-up cleanly. The only console errors are the Cloudflare RUM beacon failing CORS against localhost, which is a dev-server artifact rather than a page defect. The photography subnav row renders clipped under the global header at 390; /photography/albums, which this change does not touch, clips identically, so it is pre-existing and left alone here.
scope: stat grid and Album Reach table reflow
